missing: The read-only browse trial's final 390px mobile step still fails on a defect that predates TS-066: at 390px a double-click on a result entry enters the quick image preview and the details drawer is not rendered. Recorded as blocked, never as passing; the probe output is in docs/handoffs/TS-066.md sections 7.4 and 9.

The recheck-after-recheck page state gap found this round: filing a recheck makes the server file that recheck's own report as a new version of the library's result, while the page keeps the version it read, so a later export is refused with 409 dedup_version_conflict. The browser flow therefore exports before rechecking. Not fixed (outside this round's cards); recorded in docs/handoffs/TS-066.md section 9.

The late-recheck race is still not reproducible in the real trial (the worker claims and runs one attempt at a time), so it stays covered by the in-process deterministic case DedupRecheckFenceTests.ALateVerdictNeverReplacesANewerAnalysisOfTheSameLibrary, reverse-probed.

risks: Report retention is a bounded in-process registry (8 reports, <=20000 items each): reports do not survive a service restart, which the contract states as RetentionBoundary and the page shows as 本次结果已不可读取. Durable reports would need a new migration and coordinator approval.

The shared Web budget now passes at 316,586 B JavaScript and 348,980 B JavaScript+CSS against 327,680 / 360,448, but the headroom is 11,094 B and the gate sums every emitted file, so the next Web task must not assume room.
The spec's >=1200px two-column breakpoint is 1px away from the shell's 1199px collapse breakpoint; the page follows the spec literally and the alternative is a one-line media-query change.

The read-only browse trial's final mobile step is blocked by a defect outside this card's scope (narrow-view quick preview suppresses the details drawer). While it stands, read-only-trial-e2e cannot go green for any branch, so the trial runner's exit code is 1 even though the dedup trial passes.

The trial's heartbeat interval is a composition value set to 100 ms so that an attempt on the synthetic source spans several renewals; it is a test-timing value, not a production default, and the production path it exercises is unchanged (every renewal still goes through task_health.heartbeat_durable_task and can be refused).

Six justified CA1506 suppressions exist on the workbench facade, the worker carrying both payload shapes, the finding classifier, the recheck runner, the composition root and the authorized HTTP surface. DedupJobWorker's and DedupRecheckRunner's are deliberate: each must hold related shapes together so the lease fencing stays in one place.

architecture_review.module: AssetIdentity (dedup workbench) with Host/Trial composition, AssetLink adapter request bounds, and the Web read-only workspace
reused_existing_logic: TS065 DedupAnalyzer.AnalyzeAsync/RecountAsync, DedupPlanPolicy, DedupScopePolicy, DedupAnalysisLimits, DedupCurationPlan, DedupRecountRequest/Result, SystemDedupFileDiscovery/ContentReader/SourceAvailability and SystemDedupClock: no second scanner, hasher or scheduler was added.

TaskHealth public ports only (IDurableTaskCoordinator, IDurableTaskInspector, IDurableTaskCommitGuard, DurableTaskService, PostgresDurableTaskStore, ModulePostgresSession, TaskHealthExecutionLimits, TaskHealthLogger) for task state, lease, idempotency, cancellation and recovery. The trial reads the lease through the module's own session rather than a private connection string.
LibraryStorage public query ports (ILibraryScanTargetQuery/IRegisteredLibraryRootQuery) for the registered root; no access to its storage or tables.

Web reuse of ReadOnlyWorkspace, WorkspaceNavigation, workspaceRoutes, WorkspacePrimitives, WorkspaceIcon, SessionGate, libraryMetadata helpers, styles/base.css colour variables and the styles.css import entry point. The fourth round added one shared hook (useRowWindow) instead of a third copy of the window calculation.

The new workbench operations are carried by the single existing AssetLinkClient fetch adapter rather than a second transport; the browser trial drives that adapter's real output with no route interception.
cross_module_access: Host/Trial reads the same dedup job payload through the now-public DedupJobPayloadReader and DedupJobPayload, so the worker and the HTTP surface share one payload definition instead of copying it.
Host/Trial/Dedup/TrialDedupSourceScope adapts LibraryStorage's public management query to the scope query the dedup module defines; the module never touches LibraryStorage internals.

TrialDedupComposition registers the coordinator, inspector and commit guard from one TrialDedupServices instance, so the workbench addresses exactly the durable task type it was built for instead of a second coordinator the host might otherwise construct. It also exposes that module's task data source so the trial can read lease columns with the module's own role.

A recheck is filed through TaskHealth's public coordinator under the idempotency key dedup-recheck:{taskId}:{generation}, and the module's runner re-reads the retained report before comparing, so an accepted recheck can never adopt a newer report version.
No other module's Infrastructure is referenced, no other module's tables are written, and TaskHealth contracts were not modified.

Chromium regression suite: 86 passed / 0 failed, including the three new row-window cases (idle asset list, idle library list, and a scroll/resize/view-switch/keyboard case) that fail if the subscription is destabilised again, and the 20 workbench cases covering denial, CSRF header presence, cancel, a pending recheck that must not read as unchanged, a refused recheck, the budget being restated from the server's accepted value, discarded reports, long Chinese names, keyboard order, 320/390/1024/1440 viewports, dark mode and reduced motion.

DedupReportRegistryEvidenceTests (2 cases) pin the two compare-and-write answers by name: evidence against the current version returns Filed=false with the version it wrote against, and a version the library moved on from returns Superseded with no key and no evidence. Reverse-probed by returning Filed=true, which failed the first case immediately.

The real dedup trial now asserts what the store itself recorded: the attempt is claimed (state=leased, owner=trial-dedup, generation>0), its heartbeat_at advances and its lease_until moves past the claim's window between two samples taken while it is still leased, cancellation of a running attempt ends as cancelled (succeeded is a failure), and after a restart the same task_id remains while its report is unreadable (dedup_report_not_retained on both results and revalidate).

The real browser flow in the same trial proves the page an administrator uses reaches the same server with no route mocks: administrator login, library selection, start, status/results with the duplicate pair, export (grants_file_operation=false, version matching what the page reports), recheck, and cancellation of a running second analysis, with all six operations verified from the wire.
technical_debt: In-process report registry: bounded and disclosed, but not restart-durable. A durable variant needs an AssetIdentity-owned migration starting at 0024, which this card does not add.
IDedupJobSignal is an in-process wake-up only; losing it costs one polling interval and it carries no business fact.
The page does not reload a newer report version produced by its own recheck, so an export after a recheck is refused with 409. Pre-existing, not fixed this round, recorded in the handoff's section 9.

StoreEvidenceIfCurrent always answers Filed=false even when it succeeds; the caller distinguishes it from Superseded by the key. The branch that would call it is unreachable in production because DedupPlanPolicy.Recount always supplies a non-null current plan. Pinned by test and documented rather than refactored, to avoid widening the change.
The shared Web budget passes with 11,094 B of headroom; the next Web task must not assume more, and the gate's summing unit still needs a coordinator decision if the feature set grows.
